name: ai-linkedin-assistant
description: AI LinkedIn Assistant - Production SaaS Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @linkai/server" "npm run dev -w @linkai/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @linkai/types && npm run build -w @linkai/shared && npm run build -w @linkai/server && npm run build -w @linkai/web && npm run build -w @linkai/extension
scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w @linkai/types && npm run build -w @linkai/shared && npm run build -w @linkai/extension
